newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE OKS ERGOBANK, LEVEDERIS RIGHTS ISS.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE OKS ERGOBANK, LEVEDERIS RIGHTS ISS.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved the prospectus on the upcoming rights issues of Ergobank and Levederis , it said on Thursday.

Ergobank will proceed with a 26.5 billion drachma rights issue. It will offer 6.636 million new registered shares at 4,000 drachmas. Rights entitle shareholders to seven new shares for every 20 outstanding.
Of the new shares on issue 294,000 will be available to its staff.

Moreover, the bank will proceed with a scrip issue of 604,000 shares resulting from a capitalisation of reserves. One bonus share will be distributed to shareholders of record for every 30 outstanding.
Proceeds will finance an expansion of its branch network and maintain its high capital adequacy ratio above 14 percent, the bourse said.
Levederis will tap the market for 390.5 million drachmas with an issue of 860,754 new common bearer shares and 226,598 preferred shares at 380 and 280 drachmas respectively.
The terms of the rights issue will be three new shares for every 10 outstanding. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
